entry.author: Inland Revenue NZ
entry.summary:
Are you ready to kickstart a job that works for you?

Why settle for anything less than what's ideal for you? It's time to get the balance, variety and opportunities you deserve while being supported every step of the way. Good people can go great places at Inland Revenue. Join our team of Customer Service Officers and find the passion, development, and support you've been looking for. 

Interested in a career as a Customer Service Officer? Find out more: https://inlandrevenyou.azurewebsites.net/

Find out more about a career at Inland Revenue: https://www.ird.govt.nz/about-us/careers

----------------------------------------------------------------

Follow us on social media for help with general queries relating to any of Inland Revenue's products and services: 

Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/IRDNZ/
Twitter: https://twitter.com/NZInlandRevenue
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/inland-revenue-nz/

Stay up-to-date: https://www.ird.govt.nz/

--------------------------------------------------------------------
